gates.summary: The Program, Runtime and authorization core is inventoried at an exact revision; serialized mutations, durable fencing generations, explicit stale-lock recovery and private-root guards close the known internal findings.
limitations: Independent security review remains a separate required gate.

gates.summary: Twelve public surfaces across Graph Core, Program, Runtime, authorization and additive 2.1 modules are machine-inventoried as freeze candidates.
The full npm run release:check suite passes with Runtime, 2.1, migration, compatibility, property, negative and release-readiness checks enabled.

The independent Python checker candidate passes 20 of 20 checks from a clean local clone, including qualification, hybrid plans and shadow differentials, but that exact revision is not yet public and release-eligible.
gates.blocker_reason: Publish and clean-room verify the exact independent checker revision, then bind generated results for every frozen 2.1 surface.

gates.summary: Federation, Larena-shaped and AI Employee controlled pilots pass deterministically without production effects or canonical writes.
limitations: The Larena and AI Employee artifacts are public-safe controlled pilots, not production acceptance or comparative scientific evidence.

gates.summary: An exact-scope internal follow-up passes with no unresolved critical, high or medium findings, but no attributable external independent verdict is recorded.
gates.blocker_reason: An independent reviewer who did not implement the changes must review the exact freeze revision and close all critical/high findings.

gates.summary: Legacy Graph and Mirai 2.0 Program compatibility remain covered while Project Capsule migration is dry-run, approval-first and idempotent.
The infrastructure exists but has not run against a 2.1 release-candidate package.
gates.blocker_reason: Create the RC package and run clean-room installation on Linux, macOS and Windows.

gates.summary: Confirmatory evaluation is explicitly separated from software release readiness and continues to block comparative effectiveness claims.
limitations: No stable release text may claim model independence, superiority or cost advantage as scientifically proven before confirmatory review.

gates.summary: Package metadata intentionally remains 2.0.0-alpha.3 while stable gates are open.
gates.blocker_reason: Version, release notes, tag, GitHub Release and npm metadata change only after engineering gates pass.

next_safe_action: Publish and clean-room verify the independent checker candidate, obtain an attributable exact-revision security verdict, then create 2.1.0-rc.1 and run cross-platform clean-room gates.
claim_boundary: This readiness report supports contract inventory and targeted engineering evidence only. It does not authorize production writes or establish comparative scientific effectiveness.
